bio: Celebrate a special occasion or simply relax with an Afternoon Tea at Tower Suites as you catch up over this delightful treat with a special someone. Neighbouring the iconic Tower of London, the expansive views will provide a stunning experience.  The Afternoon tea will be served in the Cento Alla Torre restaurant, located on the ground floor and combining the refined simplicity of delicious fresh Italian food, with timeless interiors, sensational views and the vibrant atmosphere of leading eateries.  Savour a selection of delectable treats, delicious finger sandwiches, indulgent pastries and fluffy scones topped with clotted cream and preserves, and choose from a wide range of carefully selected teas.  With fantastic views over the River Thames, Tower Bridge and the Tower of London, Tower Suites is one of the most scenic 5 star hotels in London. Tower Suites is located in the heart of the city’s business district and with an easy access London’s most vibrant tourist attractions.
